subject: Thursday site visit
text: I wanted to follow up on the tentative visit we mentioned last week, because the facility coordinator has confirmed that the Thursday slot remains available and the original plan still seems workable. After the pilot walkthrough, the unexpectedly good outcome was that the client approved the layout without requesting any additional structural revisions, which means our team can focus on scheduling logistics rather than redesign. If you are comfortable, I would still prefer to keep the itinerary modest: arrival before ten, a brief review of the testing area, and a short debrief near the main entrance. I can prepare a one-page agenda, but I would appreciate your view on whether the equipment access window should be mentioned as tentative until the manager returns. I would rather overcommunicate caution than create a false expectation. Please let me know if you see any conflict with your afternoon commitments, and we can adjust accordingly.
